items.title: Sarawak, Johor, Selangor Record Highest Vacancies For Specialists In MOH Hospitals
items.summary: Sarawak, Johor, and Selangor have the highest vacancies for specialist doctors in MOH. There are 1,370 unfilled specialist posts in MOH hospitals nationwide, but only 18 contract specialists. MOH has 4,127 medical officer vacancies and 4,568 contract MOs.
